title: Hegseth Grilled On Maduro Abduction; War Secy Loses Cool, Attacks CNN Reporter In Tense Exchange
text: Hegseth Grilled On Maduro Abduction; War Secy Loses Cool, Attacks CNN Reporter In Tense ExchangeDefense Secretary Pete Hegseth sparred with a CNN reporter Wednesday, sharply rebuking questions about the cost of the U.S. military intervention in Venezuela and accusing the network of being “disingenuous” in its coverage. Hegseth defended the operation as a historic success and shifted focus to other theaters of U.S. military engagement, insisting critics were grasping at angles to “undermine” the mission. His remarks followed a classified briefing with senators, where Hegseth and Secretary of State **Marco Rubio outlined plans to secure between 30 million and 50 million barrels of Venezuelan oil — to be sold on the open market as part of a broader strategy tied to U.S. objectives in the region. #PeteHegseth #CNN #Venezuela #USMilitary #MarcoRubio #VenezuelaOil #DefenseCoverage #PoliticalClash #VenezuelaIntervention #SenateBriefing #CostOfWar #USPolitics Times Of India (TOI) Is The Largest Selling English Daily In The World.
